question: In which month was the Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Awards 2024 organised by the Srjan-Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi Nrityabasa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**September**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Awards 2024 were presented to four eminent personalities:

__
 
• **Kumkum Lal:** Renowned Odissi dancer.
 
• **Guru Lakshmikanta Palit:** Eminent figure in the field of music.
 
• **Guru Dhaneswar Swain:** Renowned percussionist.
 
• **Uttam Mohanty:** Veteran actor, recognized for his contributions to Odia cinema.

The awards were presented at the 30th Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award Festival, held from September 5-11, 2024, in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who is primarily associated with the dance form of Odissi.

 
 
• He is considered as one of the pioneers who revived and popularized Odissi dance in the 20th century.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra was born in 1926 in the state of Odisha and started his dance training at a young age under the guidance of his guru, Pankaj Charan Das.
 
• He has received several awards and honors for his contribution to the field of dance, including the Padma Vibhushan, the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• Kathak, Chhau, and Manipuri are also prominent Indian classical dance forms, but they are not directly associated with Kelucharan Mohapatra.
